title: Editorial Policy
description: Read CounterCrave's standards for research, reviews, corrections, affiliate independence and responsible AI assistance.
summary: CounterCrave publishes people-first content with accountable human editing, source checks and clear affiliate disclosures.

sections.heading: Accuracy and sourcing
paragraphs: Writers must verify model names, dimensions, capacity, power, warranty and safety-related claims before publication.
Primary sources are preferred for technical facts. Unsupported superlatives and invented quotations are not allowed.

sections.heading: Reviews and recommendations
paragraphs: Products are selected for relevance to the reader's use case, not merely because they offer a commission.
A recommendation must explain its limitations and identify readers for whom a different product would be a better fit.

sections.heading: Use of AI tools
paragraphs: AI tools may assist with organization, drafting or quality checks, but they do not replace research, verification or accountable human review.
CounterCrave does not permit fabricated testing, sources, quotations, prices, ratings or product experience.

sections.heading: Corrections
paragraphs: Readers may report errors through the contact page. Confirmed material errors are corrected, and meaningful updates receive an honest updated date.

author: CounterCrave Editorial Team
